user_id = #{userId}
AND risk_level IN ('高', '极高')
AND favorite = 1
AND JSON_SEARCH(medications, 'one', CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'), NULL, '$[*].name') IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, patient, medications, risk_level, score, favorite, created_at FROM reports WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level IN ('高', '极高') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS highRisk, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = '极高' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS critical, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(score), 1), 0) AS avgScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS thisWeek FROM reports WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT jt.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reports r JOIN JSON_TABLE(r.medications, '$[*]' COLUMNS (name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.name')) jt WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND jt.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY jt.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reports WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level IN ('高', '极高') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS highRisk, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = '极高' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS critical, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(score), 1), 0) AS avgScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS thisWeek FROM reports
SELECT risk_level AS level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reports GROUP BY risk_level

SELECT jt.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reports r JOIN JSON_TABLE(r.medications, '$[*]' COLUMNS (name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.name')) jt WHERE jt.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY jt.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reports WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day
